title: Participating community development financial institution's annual reports.
bodyText:
A participating community development financial institution shall submit an annual report to the authority. The report shall:

(1) Provide information regarding outstanding principal balances of the loans under this part, loan losses, and any other information on loans under this part the authority considers appropriate;

(2) Include a copy of the participating community development financial institution's most recent financial statement; and

(3) Include information regarding the condominium associations with loans under this part.
bodyHtml:
[§514D-16]  Participating community development financial institution's annual reports.  A participating community development financial institution shall submit an annual report to the authority.  The report shall:

     (1)  Provide information regarding outstanding principal balances of the loans under this part, loan losses, and any other information on loans under this part the authority considers appropriate;

     (2)  Include a copy of the participating community development financial institution's most recent financial statement; and

     (3)  Include information regarding the condominium associations with loans under this part. [L 2025, c 296, pt of §19]
